message: No detected untrusted source handling: Data is read from local CSV files via pd.read_csv() and glob; no remote sources are used and no integrity checks (checksums, signatures) are implemented.

No detected label flipping detection: There is no code that validates label distributions, checks label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before or during training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preprocessing only removes constant/unique columns, drops high-NaN columns, and applies scaling; there is no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checking, or filtering of suspicious training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads hyperparameters from a JSON file and trains an XGBoost model, but there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision performed on any loaded model artifacts or serialized weights.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample distribution before training; labels are read and used directly without validation.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or mechanisms are imported or applied during training.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no adversarial robustness testing (no Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, or any other attack/stress-test mechanism) anywhere in the pipeline code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set isolated from training, signed/hashed evaluation data, or any other mechanism to prevent metric manipulation; the same data appears to flow through evaluation and model training without explicit separation or integrity checks.

No detected input sanitization: The preprocess() function removes constant/unique columns and NaNs for data preparation, but there is no validation of input shape, range checks, schema validation, or rejection of malformed inference requests on the inference path.
No detected output bounds checks: No code checks model outputs for NaN values, probability sanity bounds, or calibrated thresholds before returning results from the XGBoost meta-model.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses a graph-based clustering meta-learning model (XGBoost), not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
